mapper.select: select distinct p.* from sys_permission_tb p where p.status = 1 and ( exists ( select 1 from sys_user_tb u join sys_user_role_ref ur on ur.user_id = u.id join sys_role_permission_ref rp on rp.role_id = ur.role_id where rp.permission_id = p.id and u.username = #{username} and u.deleted = 0 ) or exists ( select 1 from sys_user_tb u join sys_user_department_ref ud on ud.user_id = u.id join sys_department_permission_ref dp on dp.department_id = ud.department_id where dp.permission_id = p.id and u.username = #{username} and u.deleted = 0 ) ) order by p.sort_no, p.id
